item.title: 2.0.0-beta-3
item.description:
# Doppel 2.0.0-beta-3
- Disabling Remote Access now revokes the phone key before it closes open sessions, so a phone that connects at that moment can't slip in and keep running. - You can switch a disabled profile to a different ChatGPT account, and Enable works again after Disable without signing in a second time. Doppel still checks that the live account matches the one you confirm before turning access on. - Replace Key and Update Runtime now appear while a profile is disabled, which is when they can run. - The menu notices engine changes made from the `doppel` command line within a few minutes. Running a profile on official ChatGPT now lives under each instance's Fallback Engine submenu, since clones are the normal engine. - Beta builds point at the beta update feed by default, so a beta install keeps receiving later betas.
This is a beta. Remote Access limits from beta-2 still apply: the Mac must stay awake and logged in, and macOS 14 execution, logout/login recovery and network-loss recovery still need broader testing.

# Doppel 1.1.13
- The menu now notices engine changes made from the `doppel` command line within a few minutes, instead of showing an instance on official ChatGPT until you click Refresh. - Running a profile on official ChatGPT is now under each instance's Fallback Engine submenu. Clones are the normal engine, so the menu no longer leads with it. A profile actually on the fallback still shows that at the top, with Switch Back to Doppel Engine.

# Doppel 1.1.12
- Choose Receive Beta Updates in the Doppel menu to switch to the beta update feed and check for an update immediately. The choice persists across app updates. Turn it off to wait for a newer stable release; it does not downgrade an installed beta. - Includes the latest merged clone-engine, Creator Micro and permission-probe fixes.
